DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia.

The "double bubble" sign on your abdominal X-ray confirms an obstruction at the level of the duodenum, which explains your newborn's feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting. This finding is classic for duodenal atresia, often associated with Down syndrome. Do you have any history of polyhydramnios or known fetal anomalies?
